title: Release provenance and pins
current: Main-push attestations bind immutable artifact bytes to their exact source commit. Automatic consumer proof starts only at the release boundary and binds exact producer and consumer commits; ordinary main-push artifact attestations do not dispatch consumer integration. Stage and prod share proof for one immutable pair.
desired: Preserve exact-pair proof before tagging and recheck durable successful evidence before cross-environment reuse. Accept about nine minutes of proof wait per release, within the bridge 120-minute limit; Platform checks run in parallel.
